Night Shift Production OperativeJob description
Looking for a full-time job as a production operative in the Kortrijk area, with the opportunity to work a permanent night shift after your training? In this production environment, you will help prepare orders with care.
A stable production environment
You will join a textile manufacturing company that produces floor coverings.
Your role
• You label floor mats and roll them up so they are ready for the next stage.
• You fill boxes and carefully prepare orders.
• You carry out general packing and packaging activities.
• You keep your workplace tidy and organised.
• You start with a training period during daytime hours; afterwards, you will work independently on the permanent night shift.
This is a full-time role. MERIT will provide you with personal guidance throughout your application.
Company profile
MERIT combines specialist expertise and personal guidance in the recruitment of senior roles. For this opportunity, we are introducing you to an employer in textile manufacturing in the Kortrijk area. The production environment and supportive team atmosphere provide the context for the workplace; MERIT will personally guide you as you explore this next step.

A good fit is someone who enjoys getting hands-on and enthusiastically takes on new tasks.

• You see physical work and staying active as a good way to spend your working day.
• You can express yourself well in English and use this skill confidently in the workplace.
• A stable employment history reflects your approach to work and what you are looking for in your next step.
• Your colleagues can rely on you: you are motivated, dependable and open to learning.
• You see training during daytime hours as a valuable start and are interested in progressing to an all-round production role in the longer term, depending on production needs.

Are you looking for a challenging job within one of the largest food groups in Belgium (pork meat)? Have you always been interested in pork processing and want the opportunity to learn how to debone a pig?                        

 Follow our intensive training program and quickly develop the necessary skills. As a reward for your eagerness to learn, you will receive a permanent contract.                                                   
Wij bieden
Our offer:

• Permanent contract after 25 days of training!
• Competitive salary 
• A whole bunch of benefits! Think of daily fresh meals in our company restaurant, 25% discount on personal meat orders, fun family activities, Christmas gifts, ... In short, too many to mention!

We are looking for ambitious and eager-to-learn individuals who can start early (start at 4.55 AM) and are flexible in their schedules depending on the season. 

You should be comfortable working in a cold environment and have an affinity for the food industry (pork meat), along with the associated quality and hygiene standards. 

You must be physically capable of standing and working all day and place importance on workplace safety. 

Language is not a barrier; everyone has equal opportunities, whether you speak English, French, or Dutch.

Westvlees guarantees sustainable production of pork. Their mission is to provide a healthy and tasty solution for every consumer at every meal occasion. As an employer, they place great importance on innovation, service, and quality, while centering family values in the company, which are essential to its operations.

• Strong organisational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Fluency in Dutch and English; French and/or German are considered an advantage.
• The flexibility and adaptability to thrive in a changing environment and support process improvements.

targets, KPIs, and service deadlines while maintaining high-quality standards.

international travel (approximately 50%), including overnight stays across the EMEA region.

valid driver's license and have a clean driving record.

Senior Accountant (m/v/x) - Shared Service Center (German-speaking) - Brussels

 

On behalf of our client, a leading international group in energy infrastructure, Robert Half is looking for a Senior Accountant for its newly established Shared Service Center in central Brussels.

• You have hands-on knowledge of BEGAAP and/or GEGAAP and IFRS.
• You are proficient in SAP. Experience with S/4HANA or Public Cloud is a strong plus.
• You speak fluent English and good German. French or Dutch is a plus.
• You are autonomous, structured, service-minded and comfortable with change.

jobs.occupation: Service Delivery Director | BENELUX | Industry Finance
jobs.description:
As Industry Delivery Director Financial Services, you take overall responsibility for the successful delivery of services and solutions across a strategic portfolio of banking and insurance clients. You work alongside the Client Director, combining commercial ambitions with a delivery organization that performs reliably, efficiently and at scale. You are the senior delivery counterpart for our clients and ensure that commitments made by Cegeka translate into successful outcomes. You connect client expectations with Cegeka's delivery capabilities across service lines, countries and our Global Delivery Network.

 

• You take overall responsibility for delivery performance across a strategic portfolio of Financial Services clients, ensuring that services and projects are delivered according to agreed quality, scope, timelines and commitments.
• You act as a senior delivery partner to the Client Director and the client, bringing a delivery perspective into strategic account discussions and ensuring that commercial ambitions can be translated into sustainable and scalable delivery.
• You build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and act as an executive escalation point for critical delivery matters. You create transparency, take ownership when challenges arise and ensure that the right stakeholders are mobilized to resolve them.
• You establish and maintain strong delivery governance across the client portfolio, with clear accountability, decision-making, KPIs, service levels, risk management and escalation mechanisms. Strong governance, transparency and clear roles are particularly important when delivery spans multiple teams and locations. [Kennismaking Cegeka | Meeting]
• You continuously monitor delivery performance and identify opportunities to improve quality, customer satisfaction, operational efficiency and cost to serve. In Cegeka's new operating model, these delivery measures are distinct from the Client Director's P&L and growth accountability. [Short brie...assessment | Teams]
• You connect the different parts of Cegeka needed to deliver successfully, working across Service Lines, Industries, countries and the Global Delivery Network. You make sure that delivery functions as one organization towards the client rather than as separate teams or locations. [HR BE - ch...in - LEAP | Meeting]
• You help define the right delivery and resource model for your clients, balancing local, nearshore and offshore capabilities and ensuring that the right expertise is available at the right time. Cegeka is increasingly organizing delivery across locations including Belgium, Romania, Greece, India and Colombia. [Kennismaking Cegeka | Meeting]
• You anticipate operational and delivery risks and take action before they impact the client. When delivery performance comes under pressure, you bring structure to the situation, establish clear priorities and lead recovery or transformation initiatives.
• You contribute to major pursuits and transitions by ensuring that proposed solutions are deliverable, scalable and operationally sustainable. You provide delivery input into resource models, governance, transition plans, risks and commitments before major engagements are signed.
• You lead and develop senior delivery professionals and create an environment of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement. Depending on the final organizational setup, the role may include both functional and hierarchical leadership. Cegeka's existing executive delivery profile is classified as both functional and hierarchical coordination. [Executive...ry Manager | Word]
• You help further professionalize Cegeka's delivery organization by building scalable ways of working, strengthening governance and sharing best practices across clients and countries.
What you need to succeed:
• You have at least 15 years of relevant professional experience, including significant experience in senior service delivery, IT operations, managed services, outsourcing, transformation or program leadership.
• You have successfully led complex, business-critical IT delivery environments, ideally covering multiple technologies, teams, suppliers and countries.
• You have experience managing large-scale delivery in areas such as managed services, application services, cloud/infrastructure, security, data or digital transformation. Breadth is more important than being the deepest technical expert in one specific area.
• You understand the dynamics of Financial Services and are comfortable operating in highly regulated, business-critical environments where resilience, security, compliance and service continuity matter.
• You have a strong understanding of delivery economics and can balance customer commitments, quality, capacity, productivity, risk and cost.
• You have extensive experience with governance, SLA/KPI management, executive reporting, risk management and escalations, and you know how to turn complex delivery issues into clear decisions and actions.
• You have experience working with distributed and international delivery models, including combinations of local, nearshore, offshore and partner resources.
• You are comfortable operating at C-level and senior management level, both internally and with clients. You can challenge constructively, communicate transparently when delivery is under pressure and build trust through ownership and follow-through.
• You are a strong people leader who can bring different teams together, provide direction to senior professionals and create accountability without becoming involved in every operational detail.
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and English. Knowledge of French is a strong asset.
• You are based in Belgium and are comfortable working in a hybrid environment, with regular presence at Cegeka offices and client locations.

jobs.occupation: Electromechanical Technician - motors & machinery | Brucargo | ENG
jobs.description:
For a technical maintenance company operating at the airport, we are looking for a Electromechanical Technician – Motors & Machinery. As a Electromechanical Technician – Motors & Machinery, you will be responsible for the maintenance, repair, and servicing of electrical systems on a wide range of Ground Support Equipment (GSE), including pushback tractors, baggage tractors, belt loaders, GPU units, passenger steps, and other motorized vehicles. You will ensure that all electrical systems operate safely, efficiently, and in compliance with current standards.

Your responsibilities include:
 

 
•  
 Performing maintenance, repair, and servicing of electrical systems on GSE equipment (pushback tractors, baggage tractors, belt loaders, GPU units, passenger steps, etc.). 

 
• Troubleshooting and resolving faults in electrical and electronic assemblies. 
 
• Installing, testing, and commissioning electrical systems according to current safety standards and regulations. 
 

 
• Documenting maintenance and repair activities and contributing to technical reports. 
 
•  
Providing on-the-job training to other mechanics on troubleshooting and complex electrical systems. 

 
• Ensuring compliance with legal regulations, safety standards, and quality assurance guidelines. 
 
•  
Keeping tools, equipment, and test devices in good working condition through routine checks and cleaning. 

 
• Preparing equipment for handover to customers or deployment on airport sites. 
 

 
• Coordinating with mechanical, electrical, and workshop technicians to ensure efficient and safe execution of repair and maintenance tasks. 

 
• Completed vocational training as an industrial electrician, electronics technician for industrial engineering, mechatronics technician, or a comparable qualification. 
 
• Extensive experience in the maintenance and repair of electrical systems, ideally in aviation or a related technical field. 
 
• Experience with high voltage equipment, preferably with certification. 
 
• Extensive knowledge of control technology and proficiency in reading circuit diagrams. 
 
• Excellent communication skills to report issues and collaborate with other workshop personnel. 
 
• Good command of local language as well as English language, both spoken and written. 
 
• Class B driving license, additional driving permits are an advantage. 
 
• Possess or are eligible to obtain an airport security pass and an airport driving permit.
